meta.description: Root-cause frames. Cause rules in rules.kb link confirmed faults plus discriminating evidence to these causes; 'prevent' names the preventive action that removes the cause.

fatigue_end_of_life.name: Rolling-contact fatigue at end of life

low_suction_head.name: Low suction level / restricted suction valve

dry_running.name: Dry running of the seal faces

supply_unbalance.name: Unbalanced supply (single-phase loads, transformer, loose connections)

open_phase.name: Open phase: blown fuse, open contactor pole or loose terminal

frequent_starting.name: Frequent / heavy starting (thermal-mechanical stress on cage)

high_inertia_starting.name: High-inertia or jammed load during starting

low_supply_voltage.name: Low supply voltage (higher current for the same load)

insufficient_cooling_low_speed.name: Insufficient heat removal at low spindle speed

improper_cutting_parameters.name: Cutting parameters outside the power window

worn_tool_high_torque.name: Worn tool under high cutting torque

tool_beyond_life.name: Tool used beyond its wear life

dryer_valve_leak.name: Leaking air-dryer tower or drain valve

downstream_pipe_leak.name: Leak in pipes, fittings or a consumer downstream of the dryer
